days.do: Open Wise USD/EUR. Open Lemon Squeezy and Polar; run a US$1 test buy on each to prove payout to Wise from Brazil. Rename LinkedIn. Set F5Bot alerts on pricing keywords.
Apply to GLG, AlphaSights, Guidepoint and Third Bridge with 3 topic tags. Read the Mercor contract for conflict clauses first. Create the Respondent profile.
Build the async-reviews page on Carrd with Lemon Squeezy checkout: Review US$490/US$990, Model US$590, Raise-Ready US$790, +50% rush. Write the Tally intake form.
Publish LinkedIn teardown #1 (credit-margin math on a public AI pricing page). DM 20 seed-Series B AI founders: 3 founding Diagnostic slots.
Build the free AI Burn Check in Google Sheets and gate it with a Kit page. Draft the post 'How to budget AI spend for 2027'.
Build the pro-firm-pricing Client Margin Audit tab (margin per client, below-floor flag, suggested fee) and the 3-email price-increase sequence.
Rest half day. Review F5Bot hits. Answer 5 threads in r/SaaS or Indie Hackers with real margin math and no links.
Build the Quick Calc credit-margin calculator in Sheets. List the 'Credit Design' founding Sprint at US$2,500 (3 seats, then US$4,500). Publish teardown #2.
Build the ai-spend-fpa Core template and price it on Lemon Squeezy. Post the Burn Check on LinkedIn and in 3 subreddit threads found by F5Bot.
Add the AI-fee FAQ and call script to pro-firm-pricing. Build the Carrd page: Solo US$49, Firm US$149. List 30 US/UK bookkeeping or CPA firm owners.
Send 15 async-reviews offers: a free 3-bullet critique of the prospect's pricing page, then the US$490 offer. Follow up the day-4 Diagnostic notes.
Publish LinkedIn teardown #3. Start the AI Pricing Index sheet (date, product, plan, price, unit, credit value) with 20 products.
Finish the pro-firm-pricing kit. Email the 30-firm list on Monday. Soft-launch the ai-spend-fpa template to the Kit list. Log every sale and call in one CRM.
Weekly gate review: payout test passed, 1+ paid review or Diagnostic deposit, 1+ expert-network invite, Burn Check opt-ins. If payout failed, move checkout to Gumroad or Payhip.

streams.name: LinkedIn pricing practice
streams.why: Best credential fit of any service. Diagnostic and Sprint bring USD in month 1. A cash engine, not passive; it feeds the product streams.

steps.do: Pick the practice name and promise. Rewrite the LinkedIn headline and Featured section around the Diagnostic.
Build a one-page Carrd site: 3 fixed-price offers, sample Diagnostic outline, Tally intake, Stripe payment links.
Build the 25-check Pricing Page Scorecard (Kit-gated) and a 100-page teardown database. Write 12 posts ahead.
Post 3x/week plus 1 Friday teardown; leave 8-10 substantive comments daily. Pre-sell 3 founding Diagnostics at US$1,500.
Build the Diagnostic memo and billing-export templates. Deliver founding Diagnostics, log time, get named testimonials.
Launch the biweekly LinkedIn newsletter 'Price Signals'. Set full prices and invoice via Stripe into Wise USD/EUR.
Build the Sprint kit (Tally WTP survey, price model, packaging matrix). Pitch the US$6,000 Portfolio Clinic to 15 leads.
Run the day-90 gate review. Launch the Desk retainer at Sprint handoff. Hire a part-time BR analyst (R$3,000-5,000/mo).

streams.kpi: 6 paid Diagnostics (founding counts), 300 Scorecard subscribers, 3,000 median impressions by Day 90
streams.gate: Day 90 KILL: under 2 paid Diagnostics, under 10 qualified inbound, median impressions under 1,500. SCALE: 3+ Diagnostics/mo twice and 30% Sprint conversion.

streams.name: Productized async reviews
streams.why: Fast USD. The pricing page is public, so the first touch is free. US$490-990 is an easy yes against US$3-9k of value. Feeds Diagnostics.

steps.do: Write the 3 SKUs with scope, turnaround and exclusions. Build deck, model and pricing QA checklists.
Build the Carrd landing page and Lemon Squeezy checkout (Stripe Brasil fallback). Tally intake form fires after payment.
Write AI first-pass prompts (pre-reads only). Build the Investor Objection Checklist lead magnet and Kit sequence.
Run 5 founding reviews at 50% off for testimonials. Set F5Bot alerts; answer 3-5 Reddit/IH threads daily with no link.
Post 2 anonymised teardowns a week on LinkedIn. Email 20 accelerator managers a 10-review cohort pack at US$2,400.
List Deck and Model reviews as Upwork Project Catalog items. Automate post-delivery Kit emails.
Launch the Founder Desk subscription and Raise-Ready Pack. Record one YouTube teardown a week. Launch the PT BR edition.
Raise prices if over 12 orders/mo. At over 20 reviews/mo hire a deck-review subcontractor at US$110-130 each.

streams.kpi: 5 founding reviews by Wk 2; 4 full-price orders/mo by month 2, 10 by month 4, 18+ by month 9; AOV US$420+
streams.gate: KILL if under 5 full-price orders by day 90 after 300 touches and 12 posts; drop deck reviews first. SCALE at 15+ orders/mo twice. Cap 14h/wk.

streams.name: AI product pricing toolkit
streams.why: Lead engine for AI-pricing buyers. The money is in Sprints and VC licences, not the file. Credit-pricing pain is acute now.

steps.do: Run the US$1 payout test (Lemon Squeezy, Polar to Wise from Brazil). Buy domain, build Carrd page, set up Kit.
Build the free Quick Calc sheet. Fill the model price table from official vendor pages with source URL and date.
Interview 5 AI founders (30 min each) on COGS per user and credit design. Get permission to anonymise numbers.
Build APM-1 (9 tabs) in Excel, port to Sheets, test on 2 founders' numbers. Record a 25-minute Loom; write the sales page.
Write 30 teardowns (each a post and blog page). Soft-launch APM-1 at US$99; compile the TDP-Q4-26 pack and bundle.
Publish 3 SEO pages embedding the calculator. One Reddit/IH post a week. Launch Teardown Pro; productise the Sprint.
Run a US$300-500 ad test (stop above US$4 per email). Pitch 5 guest posts to Growth Unhinged, Ibbaka, SaaStr and others.
Launch a 30% affiliate programme. After 30 paid model sales, launch the Maven cohort and PT course (R$497) on Hotmart.

streams.kpi: 40 paid sales and 500 subscribers by month 3; 1 Sprint by month 4, 3 by month 6; opt-in 25%+ by Wk 6
streams.gate: Wk 10 KILL: under 20 paid sales and under 500 subscribers; fold APM-1 into model-templates. SCALE: opt-in 25%+, buyer conversion 2.5%+, cost per email under US$4.

streams.name: AI spend FP&A kit
streams.why: Ship before 15 Nov 2026 to catch Q4 budgeting. A wedge into ai-product-pricing Sprints. Copyable, so expect a 12-24 month window.

steps.do: Validate demand: log 30 pain quotes from Reddit/LinkedIn and DM 15 finance people at AI startups. Need 3+ who would pay.
Build the vendor price table (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, plus seat and overage prices).
Build the free AI Burn Check sheet (run-rate, 3-case 12-month projection) and gate it behind a Kit email form.
Build the Core template: inputs, price table, 24-month forecast in 3 scenarios, actuals, budget-vs-actual.
Build Pro connectors (Apps Script on OpenAI and Anthropic usage APIs). Give Pro to 5 finance beta users for feedback.
Open the Lemon Squeezy store, Carrd page and Gumroad mirror. Write the welcome and post-purchase sequences in Kit.
Launch: 5 LinkedIn posts in 10 days; free sheet on r/FPandA and Indie Hackers; submit to Product Hunt and Eloquens.
Record the 6-module course; add 4 SEO pages; pitch 10 guest spots; productise the Sprint; launch the US$19/mo Monitor.

streams.kpi: 10 paid orders and 300 subscribers by Wk 6; US$2,500/mo net by month 6; US$6,000/mo by month 12
streams.gate: KILL or downgrade to lead magnet: under 3 of 15 DMs would pay, under 10 orders in 30 days, or under US$1,000/mo at month 6. SCALE: 3% conversion and 1 Sprint/mo.

streams.name: Pricing kit for professional firms
streams.why: The Nov-Jan engagement-letter window: ship the 2027 Price Increase Kit before 2 Nov. Semi-passive US$2-6k/mo; it does not clear the floor alone.

steps.do: Build the Client Margin Audit tab (margin per client, below-floor flag, suggested fee) and the 3-email increase sequence.
Add the AI-fee FAQ and call script. Build the Carrd page (Solo US$49, Firm US$149). List 30 US/UK firms with 3-20 staff.
Finish the kit. Email the 30-firm list Monday. Get Lemon Squeezy or Polar checkout and the Kit sequence live by 2 Nov.
Launch on LinkedIn with a 90-client example, 3 posts/week. Answer r/Bookkeeping and r/taxpros. Pitch Jason Staats/Earmark.
Record the 90-minute masterclass and bundle. Pitch 15 podcasts and newsletters (Earmark, Going Concern, others).
Apply to CPA Academy as a content provider. Pitch Financial Cents Academy a co-webinar; check CPE sponsor rules.
Record the course 'Price the Outcome, Not the Hour'. Package the Workshop and sell it to free fee-teardown callers.
At 40+ buyers launch the US$199/yr tools-and-benchmark plan. Build the PT-BR edition with CBS/IBS lines on Hotmart.

streams.kpi: 40 paid kits and 300 subscribers by 31 Jan 2027; calculator opt-in 25%+ by Wk 6; 1 workshop sold by month 4
streams.gate: KILL 31 Jan 2027 if under 40 paid kits, 0 workshop deposits and under 300 subscribers: pivot to agencies. SCALE: 1 workshop/mo at US$2,500, then US$3,500.

streams.name: Expert-network calls
streams.why: Near-zero setup and US$200-280 net per call. USD in weeks 2-4. Builds market intelligence and credibility. Capped at 5 h/week.

steps.do: Check the Mercor contract for conflicts. Write the expert bio in EN/PT/ES (12 topics, 3 angles). Rewrite LinkedIn.
Register with GLG, AlphaSights, Guidepoint, Third Bridge and Arbolus. Set the rate at US$300/h, never below US$250.
Register with 7 smaller networks (Dialectica, Coleman, Atheneum, AlphaSense, Office Hours, Zintro, Capvision). Set a Gmail filter.
Write 10 screening-answer snippets. Send 25 recruiter requests. Publish a CBS/IBS pricing article in EN and PT.
Reply to every invite within 30 minutes (08:00-20:00 BRT). Accept surveys paying US$50+. Prep 15 minutes per call.
Join transcript libraries (Third Bridge, AlphaSense). Set up the Brazil tax structure with an online accountant.
After 10 completed calls raise the rate to US$375 on GLG, AlphaSights and Guidepoint. Post biweekly on general topics.
Package the US$4,500 Diligence Sprint for self-sourced leads only. At month 6 drop networks with 0 invites in 90 days.

streams.kpi: 12 networks live by Wk 2; 3 calls/mo by month 3, 6 by month 6, 10 by month 12; net per call US$200 to US$280
streams.gate: KILL to 1 h/wk if after 4 months under 2 calls/mo and under 6 invites/mo. SCALE at 6+ calls/mo twice: raise rate 15-25%, add survey panels, launch the Sprint.

streams.name: Paid research participation
streams.why: USD cash from week 2 at low capital, plus market intelligence on pricing and AI. Supporting stream; dropped in Phase 3.

steps.do: Set up payout rails (Wise USD details, PayPal). Write a canonical profile doc with true titles, dates and tools.
Rewrite the LinkedIn headline for expert-network search. Fully complete Respondent.io and User Interviews profiles.
Apply to expert networks: GLG, AlphaSights, Guidepoint, Third Bridge, Dialectica, Atheneum, Coleman, Arbolus, NewtonX.
Join panels (UserTesting, Userlytics, Trymata, TestingTime, dscout, Wynter, Prolific). Note which accept Brazil residents.
Build the Google Sheets tracker. Route study emails to a RESEARCH-HOT Gmail label with alerts. Install Espanso snippets.
Screen twice daily (20 min). Run 3-5 UserTesting tests for ratings. Answer vetting calls precisely; exclude Mercor information.
Review effective USD/h monthly; drop platforms under US$25/h. Raise the expert rate to US$300/h after 5 good calls.
Run the day-90 kill/scale checkpoint. Log anonymised themes. Record each USD receipt at the PTAX rate for carne-leao.

streams.kpi: 18 profiles live by Wk 1; 4 B2B sessions/mo and US$60/h effective by month 3; US$1,000/mo net by month 6
streams.gate: Day 90 KILL to opportunistic mode (about 1 h/wk) if net under US$300/mo and pay under US$40/h. SCALE at 2+ expert calls/mo. Never loosen screeners.

streams.name: Faceless AI pricing YouTube channel
streams.why: Traffic engine: weekly AI pricing teardowns and a monthly AI Pricing Index feed products and leads. Calebe's name, not his face.

steps.do: Audit the top 20 videos for each of 12 target keywords: views, age, length, whether a downloadable model is offered.
Set up the brand channel, Lemon Squeezy store and Kit page. Build the free AI Pricing Calculator.
Build the production pipeline: script template (hook with a number), USB-mic voiceover, 3 thumbnail templates.
Publish videos 1-2 (10-14 min) with model links in the description. Cut 3 Shorts from each.
Run 12 Trade-Off-Method WTP interviews (6 founders/PMs, 6 FP&A/students). Launch T1 in Wk 4 with a T2 order bump.
Publish 2 long-form videos and 4-6 Shorts a week. Script Mon, record Tue, edit Wed-Thu. Reply to comments within 48h.
Record course C1 (6 modules) from interview insights and pre-sell it to the list. Run a US$300 in-stream ad test.
Apply for YPP at 1,000 subs and 4,000 watch hours. Launch the Vault in month 5. Hire an editor (US$25-50/video) in month 6.

streams.kpi: 18 long-form videos by Wk 12; 500 subscribers by month 3; 15+ C1 pre-sales by Wk 10; US$30+/1k views by month 6
streams.gate: Month 7 KILL if under US$15 per 1k views and under 2 diagnostics sourced: go LinkedIn-only. SCALE: a video over 50k views or a cluster over US$40 per 1k views.

streams.name: Model template library
streams.why: Satellite lead engine: one Sprint from a PV buyer outweighs 50 template sales. Re-lists SKUs already built; not a floor-clearer.

steps.do: Open Payhip and Etsy; US$1 test purchase to a BR bank. Register on eFinancialModels; read its price-parity terms.
Map competitor prices (top 10 eFM listings, 20 Etsy results per keyword). Write a 15-row model style guide.
Build PV-03 and PV-01 first (they carry the wedge), then VA-01 DCF + Football Field and the free LBO Short-Form.
Submit to eFM with long descriptions. Go live on Payhip with the free lead magnet, 5-email sequence and order bump.
Build VA-04 SaaS model and VA-02 LBO Long-Form. List both on eFM and Payhip at the same price.
Etsy launch: PF-01, PF-02, PF-03 and VA-03 as Google Sheets downloads, 13 tags and 10 images each.
Pre-sell the Pricing Toolkit at US$299/US$990; build PV-02/04/05 only at 5+ pre-orders. Launch Update Club (US$19/mo).
Ship BR-01 CBS/IBS simulator. Post 4 LinkedIn carousels. Run a US$300 capped ad test. Day-90 SKU review.

streams.kpi: 10 SKUs live by Wk 8, 25 by month 6; 0.5+ sales per SKU/mo at day 90; 4+ downstream leads/mo by month 9
streams.gate: Day 90 KILL: a SKU under 0.5 sales/mo gets no promotion; catalogue average under 0.5 stops building. SCALE: PV SKUs over 2 sales/mo get a hosted calculator.

streams.name: B2B pricing research shop
streams.why: 2-3 fixed-fee WTP studies a month close the floor gap fast. The AI pricing report and sponsors become the semi-passive part.

steps.do: Register a domain. Build a Carrd page with 3 fixed-price offers and a sample deliverable for a labelled fake firm, 'Acme AI'.
Build the analysis engine (Van Westendorp in R, Gabor-Granger in Python) and a Quarto report with a 15-slide readout.
Build Tally survey templates. Run the US$150 Prolific pilot (target: US$4 or less per complete, 30% or less excluded).
Field the N=200 AI Copilot WTP mini-benchmark (about US$600) as a free sample. Write the SOW, DPA and billing set-up.
Build a 300-company Seed-Series B list. Send 15 personalised emails a day. Offer the founding Pulse at US$2,900.
Deliver the first 3 studies and log hours. Launch the US$149 DIY Kit. Pre-sell sponsorships to 25 usage-billing vendors.
Pass the Wk 10 sponsor gate, then field RPT-AI27 (N=500, US$2,500-6,000). Launch with a gated summary and sponsor webinar.
Launch the quarterly tracker subscription. DM 30 consultants on white-label work. Hire a part-time analyst (R$4-6k/mo).

streams.kpi: 3 studies by Wk 8; 1+ sponsor at US$7,500 (or 40 pre-orders) by Wk 10; US$8,000/mo study revenue by month 6
streams.gate: Wk 10 KILL: under 2 paid studies and under 150 subscribers and no sponsor interest. Kill the report if it sells under 20 licences. SCALE: 3+ studies/mo twice.

streams.name: Course library
streams.why: A fenced bottom rung and lead engine, built only after 30 paid model sales. A Maven cohort adds about US$3-6k/mo; Udemy is for discovery.

steps.do: Screen 6 candidate courses x 3 languages on an SPA grid (Udemy demand, competition, fit).
Run 10 Trade-Off-Method interviews (8 AI/SaaS founders and PMs, 2 BR analysts) and record switching points.
Open Udemy (W-8BEN, Payoneer), Payhip or Lemon Squeezy, Hotmart, Kit. Build the free Token-Margin and Price Floor Calculator.
Record Course 1. Build the Pro Kit with a 40-product teardown table. Pre-sell at US$149; need 10+ sales from 300+ opt-ins.
Launch Course 1 on Udemy. Send coupons to the first 100 people for early reviews.
Record Courses 2-3 (WTP Without Surveys; Funding and Pitch). Localise to PT/ES. Sell Valuation & FP&A (PT) on Hotmart at R$397.
Set up the Founder Finance Bundle (US$297), the 7-email Kit welcome sequence and a 30% affiliate programme.
Sell team licences to 30 accelerators (US$990 per cohort, beta). At 15+ Pro Kit sales/mo run the Maven cohort at US$995.

streams.kpi: Course 1 live Wk 5; 8 listings Wk 10; rating 4.4+ on 50+ ratings by month 4; Pro Kit 15 sales/mo by month 12
streams.gate: KILL any SKU under 10 paid sales/mo after 90 days; stop PT ads above R$10 per lead. Under 4 pre-sales: cut to Udemy plus calculator. SCALE: Pro Kit 15+/mo.

streams.name: Roteiro Testado travel itineraries
streams.why: A second, uncorrelated income from the 50-country itinerary archive. Faceless. Launches for the Oct 2027 sakura planning window.

steps.do: Inventory itineraries (country, days, year visited, language). Score by keyword demand. Lead with Japan for Brazilians.
Build the site (WordPress or Astro, /pt /es /en) on a brand-name domain. Apply to Travelpayouts and other affiliates.
Write the master page template 'Roteiro X dias': summary table, days 1-N, real-cost box, verified date.
Build the premium format (Canva PDF, My Maps, budget Sheet) for Portugal, Italy, Japan. Build the checklist lead magnet and email flow.
Run 8-10 Trade-Off-Method interviews. Launch the async custom plan (Tally intake, Lemon Squeezy or Hotmart, SOP).
Pinterest: 5 pins per page. Publish 2 PT pages and 2 ES translations a week. Post 3 faceless Shorts a week from Wk 7.
List premiums on Thatch and Etsy. Run a US$300 max Meta ad test. Gate: 5+ audits or 10+ templates pre-sold in 21 days.
Review affiliate EPC and SKU sales monthly. Scale to 30 PT pages, 12 SKUs. Hire an editor (R$40-60/h); try Mediavine or Raptive.

streams.kpi: 20 indexed pages by Wk 8, 60 by month 6; 0.5+ sales/SKU/mo at day 90; US$15+ affiliate revenue/1,000 views by month 6
streams.gate: Day 90 KILL: under 0.5 sales/SKU/mo and under 5k impressions/mo; stop paid SKUs, 2 h/wk. Stop custom plans under US$80/h after 5 plans. SCALE: US$25+ per 1,000 views.

streams.name: Itinerary licensing (B2B)
streams.why: A second sale of an asset already owned: about 70% of the work overlaps travel-stack. Advisors, agencies and AI planners buy the same JSON.

steps.do: Inventory every itinerary in one sheet with completeness, photo count and refresh risk.
Define the itinerary schema once (day, stop, Place ID, costs, transfer minutes). Design the white-label Docs/Canva template.
Convert the top 12 routes to full format in EN and 6 in PT. QA every timing and transfer against notes and Google Maps.
Build the one-page storefront (Carrd or Framer) with sample PDFs and licence. Confirm the BR export company form with a contador.
Hold 10 advisor discovery calls. Launch a free 10-day Portugal sample as lead magnet with a 4-email MailerLite sequence.
Email Travefy, Tern, Axus, Umapped, Tourwriter on revenue share. Export 300+ itinerary-days to JSONL; pitch 40 AI planners.
Launch the PT agency pack (R$197 each, R$1,490/yr). Pitch content bundles to 15 eSIM/insurance/card brands, 5 airline programs.
Month-3 kill-or-scale review. Grow the catalogue to 40 EN, 25 PT, 10 ES. Launch the Agency Library portal, refreshed quarterly.

streams.kpi: 10 paying customers by month 3, 40 by month 6; AI pilots (US$1,500): 1 by month 3, 3 by month 6; 1 dataset licence by month 9
streams.gate: Month 3 KILL: under 5 paying B2B customers, under US$500 revenue, 0 AI pilots after 40+ pitches. SCALE at month 6: US$5k+ AI deal, 10 library licences or a software partner.

flywheel: Tear down one public AI pricing page a week. Each becomes a LinkedIn post, a yt-finance video and an AI Pricing Index row.
End every teardown with a free tool (Quick Calc, Burn Check, Margin Audit, Van Westendorp) that captures emails in Kit.
The list buys US$49-699 files. In-file CTAs sell the US$490-990 review, credited toward a Diagnostic or Sprint.
Sprint and survey data feed the AI pricing report, which draws sponsors (~US$3k/quarter) and US$2,500/yr VC licences.
Repeated questions become a course; expert calls pick the next teardown. The travel pair is a separate, uncorrelated loop.

risks.risk: Payout to Wise from Brazil is unproven
risks.response: Run the US$1 test on Lemon Squeezy and Polar in week 1. If it fails, move checkout to Gumroad or Payhip before any launch.

risks.risk: Mercor contract may conflict with expert work
risks.response: Read the Mercor contract for conflict clauses on Day 2. Exclude confidential Mercor information from calls and screeners.

risks.risk: Conservative case misses the US$10k floor
risks.response: Net is US$8.9k at month 24. If under US$3k/mo at the month-6 review, add one fractional-roles retainer; pause course-library.

risks.risk: Streams may fail their kill gates
risks.response: Apply gates strictly: linkedin-pricing day 90, ai-product-pricing and survey-business week 10, pro-firm-pricing 31 Jan 2027.

risks.risk: Buyer overlap inflates the income forecast
risks.response: All figures are assumptions, cut 25% (40% strong case) for overlap. Base clears US$10k in month 10 (Aug 2027).
